'''Carolina Benedetti Velasquez''' is a Colombian mathematician and educator who worked as an assistant professor at the [[University of the Andes (Colombia)|University of the Andes]]. She specialized in [[Combinatorics|combinatorial]] objects, [[Algebraic geometry|algebraic]] structures, [[geometry]], [[Ehrhart polynomial]], and [[Character theory|supercharacters theory]]. She also a founder of [[Math circle|Mathematical Circles]] Colombia, an initiative designed to teach mathematical thinking to communities outside the university. She has received several fellowships, which are from the [[Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées]] (CIMPA), the Institute of the Mathematical Sciences of the Americas (IMSA) and Lluís Santaló Fellowship from [[Centre de Recerca Matemàtica]].

== Education and organization ==
Benedetti studied her bachelor's degree at the [[National University of Colombia|Universidad Nacional de Colombia]] in [[Bogotá]], Colombia. She studied her MSc in mathematics at the [[University of the Andes (Colombia)|Universidad de los Andes]], Colombia. She was awarded a PhD by the [[York University]] in [[Toronto]], Canada in 2013.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Carolina Benedetti |url=https://www.lathisms.org/calendar-2017/carolina-benedetti |access-date=16 July 2025 |website=Lathisms}}</ref> Her thesis was titled "Combinatorial Hopf algebras and supercharacters."<ref>{{Cite thesis |last=Benedetti Velasquez |first=Carolina Benedetti has worked as a visiting associate professor at [[Michigan State University]] in the United States and has been employed as an assistant professor at the Universidad de los Andes since 2023.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Quiceno |first=Juan Diego |date=26 March 2023 |title=La ecuación del amor por las matemáticas |url=https://www.elespectador.com/educacion/la-ecuacion-del-amor-por-las-matematicas/ |access-date=16 July 2025 |website=[[El Espectador]] |language=Spanish}}</ref><ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e1Wv9GAhpWQ |title=MEET a Mathematician! - Carolina Benedetti Velasquez |date=9 October 2023 |last=Meet a Mathematician |access-date=16 July 2025 |via=YouTube}}</ref> She is a member of Comunidad Colombiana de Combinatoria and the Comisión de Equidad y Género (Gender and Equity Commission),<ref name=":0" /> She is co-executive director of Mathematical Circles Colombia<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martínez |first=Eddy Josefina Pariguan |date=2020 |title=Mujeres Matemáticas en Colombia |url=https://catalogodeobras.javeriana.edu.co/items/show/433 |access-date=16 July 2025 |website=Sofía Pinzón Universidad Industrial de Santander |language=Spanish}}</ref> and founder of this initiative, which teaches mathematical thinking to students and the communities outside the university.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Varela |first=Pau |date=24 April 2026 |title=Carolina Benedetti: Lluís Santaló Visiting Fellow 2026 |url=https://www.crm.cat/carolina-benedetti-lluis-santalo-visiting-fellow-2026/ |access-date=1 May 2026 |publisher=Centre de Recerca Matemàtica |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Fellowship ==
She was a 2022 laureate of the Research in Pairs programme, awarded by the [[Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Agnes-Gomez |date=26 September 2025 |title=Interview avec Carolina Benedetti Velasquez |url=https://www.cimpa.info/en/node/7969 |access-date=1 May 2026 |publisher=Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées}}</ref> In 2024, She later received a 2024 fellowship from the Institute of the Mathematical Sciences of the Americas<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 March 2024 |title=Latin American Mathematics Unites Forces |url=https://www.icmat.es/news/reports/27-03-24-2/ |access-date=1 May 2026 |publisher=Institute of the Mathematical Sciences of the Americas}}</ref> and in 2026, she was named a Lluís Santaló Fellow, honoring the mathematician [[Luis Santaló]] that awarded by [[Centre de Recerca Matemàtica]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Vallina |first=Natalia |date=20 March 2026 |title=5 Talks, 1 Topic: A Day of Combinatorics |url=https://www.crm.cat/5-talks-1-topic-a-day-of-combinatorics/ |access-date=1 May 2026 |publisher=Centre de Recerca Matemàtica |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Benedetti is learning to play Pacific music.<ref name=":1" />
